title: 第1666章 服软的金素梅第1665章 焚墟金炎兽
slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: 无奈之下，金素梅只好向郑元发出了求救。
自己绝不能成为金乌族的罪人。
死淫贼应该就在这附近看热闹呢。
金素梅本就冰雪聪明，认定郑元是藏了起来。
呵呵！
“金姑娘，小爷凭什么帮你挡住那金炎兽？再说，这封印破开了不是更好，我也正好出去……”
郑元一脸笑眯眯的从扶桑林暗处走了出来。
没错，其实早就发现了这头大家伙。
只不过不知道是什么，原来是专门吃金乌族之人提升修为的焚墟金炎兽。
“混蛋，死淫贼，如果这大家伙跑出去，也是你给放出去的。”
金素梅狠狠瞪着郑元，恨不得把人给大卸八块了。
但那封印越来越弱，金炎兽随时都可能破开跑出去。
“那又如何，反正小爷一会跟着出去就行了。”
郑元一点没有要出手的意思，反而抱着肩膀，一副看热闹的架势。
“死淫贼，你，你可是金乌族的老祖，忍心看着族人被吃了吗？”
金素梅强压下心里的怒火，语气变得软了下来，还带着一丝哀求之意。
自己从小到大就在金乌族长大，金乌族就是自己的家。
“呵呵，金姑娘，这会你又承认本公子是金乌族的老祖了啊？”
郑元眼睛里带着似笑非笑的意味，不是那会追杀自己的时候了。
哼！
金素梅听到这话气的一跺脚，但下一刻看到越来越弱的封印急的不行。
“老祖，都是弟子错了，你赶紧挡住那头凶兽啊……”
金素梅话音里带着一丝哭腔，还有着万分的委屈。
那就是绝不能让上古焚墟金炎兽跑出去。
所以只好服软了，哀求着郑元出手。
”不错，孺子可教也。”
郑元嘿嘿一笑，金素梅这模样可爱至极，本就绝色容颜，让人不禁有种想要拥入怀里，好好怜惜一番。
“死淫贼，坏蛋……”
金素梅看着郑元的色眯眯的模样心里暗暗吐槽着。
不过可不敢说什么，现在必须要依靠死淫贼把那上古焚墟金炎兽给挡住才行。
嗷！
content_en:
In desperation, Jin Sumei had to ask Zheng Yuan for help.
He must never become a sinner of the Golden Crow clan.
The damned thief should be watching the fun nearby.
Jin Sumei, who was already very smart, decided that Zheng Yuan was hiding.
hehe!
"Miss Jin, why should I help you block the golden flame beast? Besides, wouldn't it be better if the seal is broken, and I just want to go out..."
Zheng Yuan walked out of the darkness of Fuso Forest with a smile on his face.
That's right, this big guy has actually been discovered a long time ago.
But I don’t know what it is, but it turns out to be the Burning Ruins Golden Flame Beast that specializes in eating people from the Golden Crow tribe to improve their cultivation.
"You bastard, you damn thief, if this big guy ran out, you were the one who let him out."
Jin Sumei stared at Zheng Yuan fiercely, wishing to cut him into pieces.
But the seal is getting weaker and weaker, and the Golden Flame Beast may break open and run out at any time.
"So what, I can just follow you out in a while."
Zheng Yuan had no intention of taking action. Instead, he hugged his shoulders and looked like he was watching the fun.
"You damn thief, you, you are the ancestor of the Golden Crow tribe, can you bear to see your tribe members being eaten?"
Jin Sumei suppressed the anger in her heart and her tone softened, with a hint of pleading.
I have grown up in the Jinwu tribe since I was a child, and the Jinwu tribe is my home.
"Haha, Miss Jin, now you admit that I am the ancestor of the Golden Crow tribe again?"
There was a half-smile in Zheng Yuan's eyes, it was not the time to pursue him.
snort!
Jin Sumei stamped her feet angrily when she heard this, but the next moment she saw the seal getting weaker and weaker and became anxious.
"Ancestor, it's all my disciples' fault. Hurry up and stop that ferocious beast..."
There was a hint of crying in Jin Sumei's voice, and she felt extremely wronged.
That is, the ancient Burning Ruins Golden Flame Beast must not be allowed to escape.
So he had no choice but to give in and beg Zheng Yuan to take action.
"Yes, children can be taught."
Zheng Yuan chuckled, Jin Sumei looked so cute, and her stunning appearance made people want to hold her in their arms and take pity on her.
"Damn thief, bad guy..."
Jin Sumei secretly complained when she saw Zheng Yuan's lustful look.
But I don't dare to say anything. Now I have to rely on the dead thief to block the ancient Burning Ruins Golden Flame Beast.
Ouch!
title_en: Chapter 1666 The subdued Jin Sumei Chapter 1665 The Burning Ruins Golden Flame Beast
